threads.title: The Alibi
threads.intro: Test Devika's rain alibi and the corridor log against what each record can really prove.
threads.outcome_text: The weather record contradicts the rain alibi and the access log shows a granted R-14 swipe, though neither locates the person.

threads.title: The Record Changes
threads.intro: Compare the original and replacement summaries and read the printer audit with care.
threads.outcome_text: Only the tie-break changed, and the printer shows the D.RAO account produced the revision at 3:28 PM.

threads.title: The Contradiction
threads.intro: Weigh the independent records together and identify the explanation that does not overclaim.
threads.outcome_text: The badge, the account, the contradicted alibi and the missing judge approval converge on one person.

story_events.title: The rain had stopped
story_events.body: The rainfall station recorded zero rain from 3:16 PM, while Devika says heavy rain kept her at the loading bay until nearly 3:40 PM. The corridor reader also granted her badge entry at 3:23 PM. Neither record alone proves where she was, but the story she told no longer fits.

story_events.title: Same points, new winner
story_events.body: The replacement summary keeps the total points but names Team Meridian as tie-break winner instead of Team Northstar. It was printed at 3:28 PM under the D.RAO account. The printer audit shows an account, not a person.

story_events.title: Converging evidence
story_events.body: The badge custody register shows no transfer of R-14, the judge confirms she never authorised a replacement, and the secretary notes the account and badge records alongside the rain contradiction. The evidence converges on Devika Rao without any single record being decisive.
